title: GOLDEN RELOAD INSPECTION
description: Premium weapon skins now include bespoke reload animations, tiny chamber-check flourishes, and a heroic magazine slap that plays only when the cosmetic is equipped.
consequence: The gun feel gets theatrical. The store gets something expensive enough to inspect frame by frame.

title: NO-FEE RESPEC SHRINE
description: Shrines now let players rebuild stats, weapon scaling, and spell slots without spending premium tokens, provided they kneel through one extremely judgmental animation.
consequence: Buildcraft gets less punitive. The shrine stops begging for change.

title: PREMIUM WATERING CAN SWING
description: The default watering can now has a slower windup and heavier stamina cost, while the polished premium can keeps the old snap, splash arc, and smug little sparkle.
consequence: The farm chores get heavier. The upgrade button looks suspiciously ergonomic.

title: REALISTIC CLUTCH TUTORIAL
description: Every new vehicle now requires a manual clutch calibration sequence, including stall recovery, hill starts, and a dashboard warning light that refuses to explain itself.
consequence: The cars get more authentic in the worst direction. The showroom loses its impulse-buy smell.
